source: Real renderer in the demo harness (alex/website-build, the 0.1.0 code), headless Chrome at 2x, light theme. Sample data: the fictional Pellwood launch review. The sidebar footer's status (whisper base on Metal, 0 requests) was supplied to the harness, which has no main process; it is what a packaged build shows at rest.

files.name: summary-window-2240.webp
files.shows: Full window: a finished conversation, with its title, how each question ended, the shape of the talk and talk time per person.
files.alt: Oats showing a finished conversation, Enterprise launch review: SSO gates the date, with 15 questions (9 answered, 3 unknown, 2 unanswered, 1 open), a line of the conversation marked where each question was asked, and talk time per person.

files.name: summary-window-1120.webp
files.shows: The same finished conversation at half size, for narrow screens.
files.alt: Oats showing a finished conversation, Enterprise launch review: SSO gates the date, with 15 questions (9 answered, 3 unknown, 2 unanswered, 1 open), a line of the conversation marked where each question was asked, and talk time per person.

files.name: check-live.webp
files.shows: Crop of a recording where the context check answers an unknown question from the team's notes, with the recording and topic cards above it.
files.alt: A recording at 8 minutes 25 seconds. Under the question Do we have a date from the auditors yet, marked Unknown, Oats shows Found it: Fieldwork starts November 10, from soc2-plan.md, Auditor dates.

files.name: outcomes.webp
files.shows: Crop of What this left open: every question with its verdict, and the answer under each answered one.
files.alt: The list What this left open, 15 asked and 9 answered: questions marked Unknown, Unanswered, Open and Answered, with the answer under each answered one.

files.name: sidebar-foot.webp
files.shows: Crop of the sidebar's foot: where processing runs, the speech model and the network request count, above the wheat field.
files.alt: The bottom of the Oats sidebar: Settings, then On this Mac, small.en on Metal and 0 network requests since launch, above a dithered sky and wheat field.
files.source: 0.2.0 code: `node demo/capture.mjs --only sidebar-foot --themes light` (harness `footer=small.en`: small.en loaded on Metal, 0 requests, what a packaged build shows at rest), the sidebar's last 352 CSS px at 2x, `cwebp -q 85 -m 6 -crop 0 1096 464 704`.

files.name: oats-film.mp4
files.shows: The film, 63 seconds, no sound: a launch review recorded with Oats, from the title card through the live view, the summary and the board, to the GitHub end card.
files.alt: A 63 second film of Oats recording a launch review: the live line and topics, question cards, the finished summary, connections and the board of all conversations.

files.name: oats-film-poster.webp
files.shows: Poster frame from the film at 20 seconds: the words view during the launch review.
files.alt: Oats recording a launch review at 18 minutes 20 seconds, with five topic lanes and the question How long does the full migration take on production, marked Unknown.
